picks.title: Perplexity makes it easier to run AI workflows entirely on your own Mac
picks.rationale: New Mac release: full Perplexity AI workflows run locally on 36GB+ Macs, so designers can keep client files on their own machine.
picks.excerpt: A Mac with at least 36GB of RAM can now run Perplexity AI workflows locally.

picks.title: Get hands-free personalized help on the road with Gemini
picks.rationale: Official launch: Gemini is now in cars globally (Android Auto and Google built-in), with Personal Intelligence context. Primary source, broad reach.
picks.excerpt: Gemini is available in cars globally. With Personal Intelligence, get uniquely tailored help while keeping your eyes on the road.

picks.title: Boya Notra Neo launches with AI-powered meeting transcriptions, summaries, and recordings and MagSafe mount
picks.rationale: New AI-led device launch: a MagSafe voice recorder whose main features are AI transcription in 140+ languages, speaker ID, summaries, action items and Ask AI search. Useful for designers in client calls and user interviews.
picks.excerpt: Boya's Notra Neo is a MagSafe-mount AI voice recorder that transcribes calls and meetings in 140+ languages with speaker identification, then generates summaries, action items and mind maps from 60+ templates, with an Ask AI search across recordings.

picks.title: Voxel 1 robot can tidy up, water plants and clean up dirt
picks.rationale: New product: Tuesday Labs' two-armed household robot that learns where objects belong and tidies on its own. A concrete consumer physical-AI device.
picks.excerpt: Tuesday Labs' Voxel Series 1 is a two-armed, two-legged household robot that uses AI to learn where objects belong, tidy up on its own, water plants, detect and clean dirt and put dishes away, guided by RGB and ultra-wide cameras and voice commands.

picks.title: An 'enormous influx' of new Garmin Connect IQ apps and watch faces spark fears of poor-quality AI slop flooding the store
picks.rationale: New development: AI-generated watch faces and apps are flooding Garmin's Connect IQ store. Directly relevant to designers who make wearable UI.
picks.excerpt: Garmin has a Connect IQ problem.
